join.title:
Become a member
of The Eagles
join.intro: Great that you want to join UBV The Eagles! Fill in this form and we will process your registration.

form.jerseyHint: If you want to play in the league, enter your preferred jersey number. Another member may already use it, in which case we will find a free number for you.
form.membershipHint: Enter your date of birth first to see the memberships available to you.
form.noPlans: No memberships are available for your age.
form.success: Thank you for signing up. We will contact you as soon as possible.
form.error: Your registration did not go through. Please check your details and try again. Already a member? Then you don't need to sign up again.

join.teaser: Want to play basketball with The Eagles? Sign up as a member and join in, or just come and train with us.
